notes: 'Significantly' appears only in the Summary with no test described, so the unnamed test is likely colloquial and is kept ancillary. Surveillance indicators are also compared with fixed WHO targets (≥80%, NMNR ≥2 per 100,000); 'surveillance sensitivity' is an indicator, not diagnostic accuracy. Progress is measured against elimination targets, but not in relation to a disparity, so equity_action is false.
